main_text.head: SECT. XX. De numero Mediatorum & invocatione Sanctorum.
main_text.p: AD Sacerdotium Christi non magis spectat, ipsum se victimam ἁμαρτίαν in ara crucis pro nobis semel immolare, quàm precum nostrarum thymiama, (θυμίαμα ἐυωδίας) in ara cœli, patri suo iugiter offerre: vt ergo infinita fere sacrificia, sic & innumeri mediatores Christum plane exautorare nobis videri solent: Neque certè magis in hoc mundi senio creuit intercessorum numerus, quàm impietas inuocandi;

page.notes: The Greek words in the text are printed in a small italic face; they are transcribed as closely as the scan allows. The first Greek word is read as ἁμαρτίαν-like (uncertain) and marked for checking. Show-through of text from the reverse page is present in the upper half and is omitted.
